# AMD ADL headers

Unmodified `adl_sdk.h`, `adl_defines.h`, `adl_structures.h` from
[GPUOpen display-library](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/display-library/tree/84c881cb2136f04287eb3af12de00a9e2867aa9e/include).

Pinned revision: `84c881cb2136f04287eb3af12de00a9e2867aa9e`.
The MIT copyright and permission notice is preserved in every header.
No AMD DLL is redistributed: the installed display driver supplies `atiadlxx.dll`.
